get.summary: Read-only entitlement/limit gate, served from this pod's in-process snapshot when it is live.
get.description:
This endpoint NEVER moves money or counters: it reports whether a caller is currently within
its limits and balances. Consuming the quota still requires `POST /credit-control/admit`,
which is always authoritative and never served from cache.

Every answer is labelled: `freshness.source` says where it came from, `freshness.age_ms` how
old it is, and `freshness.fallback` marks a degraded answer produced while PostgreSQL was
unreachable. A degraded answer follows the configured fail-closed / fail-open contract.

parameters.name: required_units
parameters.description: Units the caller intends to consume. Default 0 = "is the gate open".

parameters.name: required_value_units
parameters.description: Value units the caller intends to draw. Default 0 skips the balance check.

parameters.name: max_age_ms
parameters.description: Reject an answer older than this and re-read. Clamped to the configured TTL.

parameters.name: fallback
parameters.description: Per-request override of the degraded decision: `deny` or `allow`. Read-only path only.
